# ZappyOne

> ZappyOne (one word; people also search Zappy One, Zappy1 or Zappyone; website zappyone.com) is an Indian home services platform, live in Hyderabad, Telangana, and launching city by city across India. Customers book on zappyone.com or the ZappyOne Android app, see a fixed price before booking, and a verified professional or a member of ZappyOne's own salaried staff comes to their door, tracked live on a map.

- Website: https://www.zappyone.com
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zappyone.app
- Live in: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Launching city by city; every city page: https://www.zappyone.com/in
- A venture of DevUp Ecosystem: https://www.devupecosystem.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/zappyone.india
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/zappyone/
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@zappyone.india

## Services (live in Hyderabad)

- [Bike wash at home](https://www.zappyone.com/repair/bike-wash): quick, foam, or foam and polish wash at your parking, for scooters, bikes and 350cc+ bikes.
- [Car wash at home](https://www.zappyone.com/repair/car-wash): exterior, foam with inside vacuum, or full clean, for hatchbacks, sedans and SUVs.
- [Family Assist](https://www.zappyone.com/helping), done only by ZappyOne staff: grocery run, medicine pickup with prescription, parcel return or drop, doctor visit escort for elders, bank or post office or bill queue, elder daily check-in, party helper, puja and festival help.
- [Phone repair](https://www.zappyone.com/repair) and [laptop repair](https://www.zappyone.com/repair/laptop) at your door, diagnosed before you are quoted.
- [Pet grooming and care](https://www.zappyone.com/pet).
- [Event and party decoration](https://www.zappyone.com/events).

## How it works

1. Choose a service and enter your address; the app shows what is available at your location.
2. See the full price before you book. For shopping and medicine errands the shop bill is paid at actual cost, shown separately from the service fee.
3. A verified professional or ZappyOne staff member is assigned; you see who is coming and track them live.
4. Share your start code when the work begins or the item is handed over; pay after the service by cash, UPI or card.

## Trust

- Every professional completes an ID check and is approved separately for each service before taking jobs.
- Family Assist is done only by ZappyOne's own salaried staff, who check in at their hub with a live selfie and location.
- Prices are fixed before booking; there are no price ranges and no hidden charges.
